title: Masterpieces
description: The most iconic paintings of all time — start here.

items.title: Mona Lisa
items.description_narrative: Hands folded calmly before her, a woman with a faint smile sits before a hazy, mountainous landscape crossed by a winding path and a distant bridge. Leonardo da Vinci painted this portrait in the 1500s; it belongs to the Louvre.
items.tags: portrait, sfumato, renaissance, enigmatic, leonardo da vinci, landscape background
items.credit_line: C2RMF: Galerie de tableaux en très haute définition: image page

items.title: The Last Supper
items.description_narrative: Thirteen men sit along one side of a long table set with bread and cups, arranged in animated clusters of three as a calm central figure spreads his hands amid the commotion, three arched windows opening onto a hazy landscape behind. Leonardo da Vinci is credited as the painter; the image is dated from 1495 until 1498.
items.tags: religious art, group scene, renaissance, mural, leonardo da vinci, dining table

items.title: Under the Wave off Kanagawa
items.series: Thirty-Six Views of Mount Fuji (Fugaku sanjūrokkei)
items.medium: Woodblock print; ink and color on paper
items.description_narrative: A towering, claw-like wave curls over three fragile boats, its foam breaking into countless small droplets above a distant, snow-capped peak. This woodblock print by Katsushika Hokusai dates from the early nineteenth century and depicts Mount Fuji beyond a rogue wave off Tokyo Bay.
items.tags: ukiyo-e, woodblock print, great wave, mount fuji, japanese art, edo period
items.credit_line: Collection of The Metropolitan Museum of Art (JP1847, H. O. Havemeyer Collection)

items.title: The Starry Night
items.description_narrative: Van Gogh's 1889 night sky swirls in bands of blue and white around a glowing crescent moon and bright stars, a dark, flame-like cypress rising beside a quiet village of small lit windows below; the Museum of Modern Art now holds it.
items.tags: night sky, swirling clouds, cypress, post-impressionism, van gogh, village

items.title: The Scream
items.medium: Oil, tempera, pastel and crayon on cardboard
items.description_narrative: A wide-eyed figure clutches its head on a bridge, mouth open, as swirling bands of red and orange fill the sky above a dark blue, wavering landscape. Edvard Munch is credited as the artist; the image is dated 1893.
items.tags: anguish, expressionism, bridge, swirling sky, edvard munch, anxiety
items.credit_line: National Museum of Art, Architecture and Design

items.title: Primavera
items.description_narrative: Nine figures in flowing robes move together through an orange grove, three linked women dancing at center-left while a winged, blindfolded archer hovers above and a bluish figure reaches in from the trees at right. Sandro Botticelli is credited as the painter; the image is dated between 1480 and 1485.
items.tags: mythology, renaissance, allegory, orange grove, botticelli, dancing figures

items.title: The Night Watch
items.description_narrative: Two prominent figures in black and gold stride forward at the center of a crowded militia company, muskets and pikes raised at odd angles around them, while a small girl in a glowing pale dress stands out amid the shadowy uniformed men.
items.tags: militia, group portrait, muskets, dark background, gold accents, procession

items.title: Girl with a Pearl Earring
items.description_narrative: A young woman glances over her shoulder, lips slightly parted, a blue and gold turban wrapped around her head and a single luminous pearl hanging from her ear against a plain dark background. Johannes Vermeer painted this portrait around 1665; it belongs to the Mauritshuis.
items.tags: portrait, turban, pearl, dutch golden age, vermeer, oil painting

items.title: Portrait of Adele Bloch-Bauer I
items.medium: Oil, silver, and gold on canvas
items.description_narrative: Amid a shimmering field of gold spirals, eyes, and geometric patterns, a woman with dark upswept hair and an elaborate choker sits with hands clasped before a dress patterned in silver triangles. Klimt painted this portrait in 1907; the Neue Galerie now holds it.
items.tags: portrait, gold leaf, art nouveau, ornamental, klimt, vienna secession

items.title: Water Lilies
items.description_narrative: Pink and white water lilies float scattered across a rippling blue-green pond, dense clusters of lily pads crowding the edges as reflections blur into soft washes of color. Claude Monet painted these water lilies in 1906; it belongs to the Art Institute of Chicago.
items.tags: water lilies, pond, impressionism, reflections, monet, oil painting

items.title: Irises
items.description_narrative: Dense clusters of deep blue-violet irises fill the foreground, their curling green leaves crowding a bed of orange marigolds, one lone white iris standing apart from the rest. Vincent van Gogh painted these irises in 1889; it belongs to the J. Paul Getty Museum.
items.tags: flowers, garden, irises, post-impressionism, van gogh, oil painting

items.title: The Creation of Adam
items.description_narrative: Part of the painted ceiling Michelangelo completed in 1511, this panel shows a reclining figure stretching one arm toward an airborne, cloaked figure surrounded by attendants; it remains on the Sistine Chapel ceiling.
items.tags: fresco, ceiling, religious art, renaissance, michelangelo, genesis
items.credit_line: Own work Burkhard Mücke Taken on 18 October 2017

items.title: American Gothic
items.description_narrative: A balding man in round spectacles holds a pitchfork beside a woman in a dark apron dress with a cameo brooch, a white farmhouse with a Gothic window rising behind them. Grant Wood painted this in 1930; it hangs in the Art Institute of Chicago.
items.tags: portrait, farmhouse, regionalism, americana, grant wood, oil painting

items.title: Sunflowers
items.description_narrative: A cluster of sunflowers in different stages of bloom and wilt fills a plain earthenware vase, rendered in thick strokes of yellow, gold, and green against a matching yellow background. Vincent van Gogh painted these sunflowers in 1888; it belongs to the National Gallery.
items.tags: still life, flowers, yellow palette, post-impressionism, van gogh, vase

items.title: Olympia
items.description_narrative: Reclining on white sheets, a woman meets the viewer's gaze directly, a black ribbon at her throat and a single flower in her hair, as a servant behind her offers a large bouquet and a black cat arches at the foot of the bed. Édouard Manet is credited as the painter; the image is dated 1863.
items.tags: nude, portrait, realism, controversy, manet, reclining figure

items.title: The Birth of Venus
items.description_narrative: The goddess Venus emerges from the sea as a fully grown woman, arriving at the shore on a giant scallop shell. One of the world's most famous and appreciated works of art, it has become a landmark of Italian Renaissance painting.
items.tags: mythology, venus, renaissance, goddess, shell, classical

items.title: The Last Judgment
items.description_narrative: Hundreds of muscular figures rise and fall in swirling clusters across a vast blue sky, a bright central figure with one arm raised presiding over the scene, a cross visible near the bottom. Michelangelo painted this fresco in the 16th century; it belongs to the Vatican Museums.
items.tags: fresco, religious art, renaissance, monumental, michelangelo, judgment

items.title: Nighthawks
items.description_narrative: Three customers sit at a brightly lit diner counter behind a curved glass window as a server in white leans toward them, the street outside empty and cast in shadow. Hopper painted this in 1942; the Art Institute of Chicago now holds it.
items.tags: diner, night scene, urban, american realism, edward hopper, empty street

items.title: Las Meninas
items.description_narrative: Velázquez set this 1656 court scene in a shadowed room: a young girl in a pale gown stands attended by kneeling maids, a painter with brush and palette watching from the left as a large dog lies patiently in the foreground. It remains in the Museo del Prado.
items.tags: court portrait, baroque, painter, illusion, velazquez, oil painting
items.credit_line: The Prado in Google Earth: Home page 7th level of zoom, JPEG compression quality: Photoshop 8.

items.title: View of Delft
items.description_narrative: A walled town with red-roofed buildings and a tall clock tower rises beyond a broad river, small figures gathered on a sandy near bank beneath a sky heavy with dramatic, sunlit clouds. Johannes Vermeer painted this cityscape in the 1660s; it belongs to the Mauritshuis.
items.tags: cityscape, river, dutch golden age, luminous sky, vermeer, oil painting

items.title: Luncheon of the Boating Party
items.description_narrative: A relaxed group of men and women in straw boaters and summer dresses lean together at a table crowded with wine bottles and fruit, a striped awning shading them from a leafy riverside view. Pierre-Auguste Renoir is credited as the painter; the image is dated from 1880 until 1881.
items.tags: leisure, riverside, impressionism, group portrait, renoir, striped awning

items.title: Luncheon on the Grass
items.description_narrative: A nude woman sits calmly among two fully dressed men on a grassy riverbank, a woven basket of spilled fruit and bread beside her, while a second woman wades in a stream behind them. Manet painted this in 1863; the canvas now hangs in the Musée d'Orsay.
items.tags: picnic, nude, realism, riverbank, manet, controversy

items.title: Dance at Le Moulin de la Galette
items.description_narrative: Couples dance and mingle beneath strings of lantern-lit globes in a crowded outdoor garden, dappled sunlight scattering across the straw hats and striped dresses of a seated group in the foreground. Renoir painted this in 1876; the Musée d'Orsay now holds it.
items.tags: dance, crowd, garden, impressionism, renoir, oil painting

items.title: The Kiss
items.description_narrative: Wrapped almost entirely in a shimmering field of gold, a couple locked in an embrace kneel on a bed of flowering ground, rectangular patterns on his robe meeting round, floral ones on hers. Klimt painted this in 1907; the Belvedere now holds it.
items.tags: embrace, gold leaf, art nouveau, ornamental, klimt, oil painting

items.title: The Sleeping Gypsy
items.description_narrative: Rousseau's 1897 dream scene sets a figure in a striped robe asleep on sandy ground beside a mandolin and jug, a maned lion standing close over her under a full moon and a still, star-flecked sky; the Museum of Modern Art now holds it.
items.tags: dream, lion, desert, naive art, henri rousseau, moonlight

items.title: The Bedroom (Amsterdam version, 1888)
items.description_narrative: A simple yellow bed and two rush-seated chairs fill a tilted, brightly colored room, small framed pictures crowding the wall above and green shutters letting in daylight. Vincent van Gogh painted this bedroom scene in 1888.
items.tags: bedroom, interior, bold color, post-impressionism, van gogh, oil painting

items.title: The Hay Wain
items.description_narrative: A horse-drawn wooden cart fords a shallow river beside a thatched cottage, tall trees and a wide, cloud-filled sky rising over the open meadow beyond. Constable painted this in 1821; it hangs today in the National Gallery.
items.tags: countryside, river, cottage, romanticism, constable, oil painting

items.title: The Fighting Temeraire
items.description_narrative: A pale, ghostly sailing ship is towed by a small dark steam tug across still water, a blazing orange sunset and thin crescent moon framing the scene. Turner painted this in 1839; the National Gallery holds it today.
items.tags: sunset, sailing ship, steam tug, marine art, turner, oil painting

items.title: The Anatomy Lesson of Dr. Nicolaes Tulp
items.description_narrative: A black-clad lecturer holds forceps over the dissected forearm of a pale cadaver as a cluster of ruff-collared men lean in close, watching intently in a dim room. Rembrandt is credited as the painter.
items.tags: anatomy, group portrait, dutch golden age, dark interior, rembrandt, oil painting

items.title: The Art of Painting
items.description_narrative: Seen past a heavy patterned curtain, a painter in a slashed black doublet works at his easel while a young woman in blue holds a book and a long horn, a large map covering the wall behind them. Johannes Vermeer painted this scene in the 1660s; it belongs to the Kunsthistorisches Museum.
items.tags: studio scene, allegory, dutch golden age, painter, vermeer, oil painting

items.title: The Return of the Prodigal Son
items.description_narrative: A kneeling, barefoot man in tattered clothes buries his face against an elderly man's chest as the older figure rests both hands gently on his back, two other witnesses looking on from the shadows. Rembrandt is credited as the painter; the image is dated circa 1668.
items.tags: reunion, forgiveness, dutch golden age, dark interior, rembrandt, tender gesture

items.title: The Arnolfini Portrait
items.description_narrative: Dated 1434, Van Eyck's double portrait shows a man in a wide dark hat clasping the hand of a woman in a voluminous green gown, a small shaggy dog standing between them and a round mirror on the wall behind; the National Gallery holds it today.
items.tags: double portrait, domestic interior, northern renaissance, van eyck, oil painting, symbolism
items.credit_line: Web site of National Gallery, London

items.title: A Sunday on La Grande Jatte — 1884
items.description_narrative: Parasol-carrying women, top-hatted men, a leashed monkey, and lounging figures dot a grassy riverside park rendered in tiny dots of color, sailboats gliding on the water beyond. Seurat painted this in 1884; the Art Institute of Chicago now holds it.
items.tags: pointillism, park, leisure, neo-impressionism, seurat, riverside

items.title: Café Terrace at Night
items.description_narrative: Diners fill outdoor tables beneath a glowing yellow café awning, its light spilling onto the cobblestones under a deep blue, star-flecked sky. Van Gogh painted this in 1888; the Kröller-Müller Museum now holds it.
items.tags: night scene, cafe, stars, post-impressionism, van gogh, oil painting

items.title: Starry Night Over the Rhône
items.description_narrative: Streaks of golden gaslight ripple down into a dark blue river beneath a star-dotted sky, a couple walking arm in arm along the near bank and two small boats moored at the water's edge. Vincent van Gogh is credited as the painter; the image is dated September 1888.
items.tags: night sky, river reflection, stars, post-impressionism, van gogh, couple walking

items.title: Wheatfield with Cypresses
items.description_narrative: This oil on canvas by Vincent van Gogh was painted in 1889 and is held in the National Gallery. It shows a golden wheatfield beneath swirling clouds, with a tall dark cypress tree and distant blue mountains.
items.tags: van gogh, post-impressionism, wheatfield, cypress, landscape, provence

items.title: The School of Athens
items.description_narrative: Dozens of robed figures fill a grand vaulted hall lined with statues, two central figures in conversation beneath a soaring arch as others read, gesture, and lean over books on the steps below. Raphael painted this fresco in 1512; it remains in the Vatican Museums.
items.tags: fresco, philosophy, renaissance, architecture, raphael, grand hall
items.credit_line: "School of Athens" by Raphael, Raphael Rooms, Vatican Museum Complete indexed photo collection at WorldHistoryPics.com.

items.title: Bacchus and Ariadne
items.description_narrative: A leaping, garlanded figure startles a woman in flowing blue drapery on a shoreline, while cheetahs pull a cart and cymbal-clashing revelers spill from the trees behind him. Titian painted this mythological scene in the 1520s; it belongs to the National Gallery.
items.tags: mythology, renaissance, movement, revelers, titian, oil painting
items.credit_line: Own work Joyofmuseums Taken on 16 July 2018

items.title: Virgin of the Rocks
items.medium: Oil on panel, transferred to canvas
items.description_narrative: A seated woman in blue and orange drapery gathers two infants and a kneeling angel close around her within a shadowy, rock-walled grotto, a hazy blue landscape glimpsed through an opening at left. Leonardo da Vinci is credited as the painter; the image is dated between 1491 and 1506, and it belongs to the National Gallery.
items.tags: religious art, grotto, renaissance, madonna, leonardo da vinci, sfumato

items.title: The Raft of the Medusa
items.description_narrative: Géricault completed this 1819 scene of survivors crowding a makeshift raft, one man hoisted up waving cloth toward a distant ship on the horizon while lifeless bodies lie draped across the timbers beneath a stormy sky; the Louvre holds it today.
items.tags: shipwreck, survivors, romanticism, marine art, gericault, stormy sky
